     2	
     3	`harness.agent` says a server is the same agent with two collaborators swapped: an asker that
     4	suspends until a client answers, and an observer that publishes events. The claim is right
     5	-- nothing in `AgentLoop`, `Agent` or any tool changed to serve HTTP -- and the count is
     6	not. It is four, and the two it missed were missed for reasons worth knowing.
     7	
     8	**The observer is per-turn, and a client renders per-call.** `Observer` is told about a
     9	completed `Turn` -- the assistant message and every tool result together -- so an activity
    10	row published from there can only ever arrive already finished. A turn whose second tool
    11	call is a three-minute `pytest` shows nothing at all until the whole turn ends, and the
    12	client contract's upsert-by-`update_id` (active, then completed) never happens. So liveness
